## Why visit

One of the strongest outer-city choices for this particular brief. The carved oak and etched-glass bar serves several surviving rooms, and the cask offering includes the chance to drink a traditional local mild in an appropriate setting. This is a rewarding alternative to another contemporary taproom and a useful reminder that beer interest need not mean a long tap list. Because it is opposite the transport interchange, the journey is relatively straightforward to plan. Make the interior and the Holt’s beer the purpose of the visit.

## Beer

Joseph Holt Bitter and Mild are documented as regular cask beers.
